hook: Dynamical codes built from measurement sequences are extended to GKP codes, with a lower-weight example.
summary: The paper builds a theory of dynamical codes for GKP oscillator qubits, giving a way to compute the syndrome and distance of a measurement sequence. In an example, a two-mode square-hexagonal Floquet code has lower measurement weight than square or hexagonal GKP codes. It is a theoretical framework with no hardware demonstration.
title: Dynamical GKP codes
